name: homepage
description: A highly customizable homepage for your homelab services.
compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/dashboard:latest
    container_name: homepage
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro

name: n8n
compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n
    container_name: n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=localhost
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_BASIC_AUTH_ACTIVE=false
    volumes:
      - ./n8n:/home/node/.n8n

name: open-webui
description: WebUI for LLMs — run Ollama or use your own model endpoint.
compose:
services:
  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    container_name: open-webui
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./open-webui:/app/backend/data

name: immich
description: Open-source photo and video management solution.
compose:
services:
  immich-server:
    image: immich-app/immich-server:latest
    container_name: immich-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    env_file:
      - .env
    volumes:
      - ./upload:/usr/src/app/upload
  redis:
    image: docker.io/redis:6
    container_name: immich-redis
  database:
    image: docker.io/postgres:14
    container_name: immich-postgres

name: paperless-ngx
description: Document management system for scanning, OCR, and archival.
compose:
services:
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
    container_name: paperless-ngx
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=UTC
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - DBHOST=postgres
    volumes:
      - ./data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - ./media:/usr/src/paperless/media

name: memos
compose:
services:
  memos:
    image: ghcr.io/uscamlet/memos/memos:latest
    container_name: memos
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5230:5230"
    volumes:
      - ./memos:/var/opt/memos

name: stirling-pdf
description: Free, open-source PDF manipulation tools (split, merge, OCR, compress).
compose:
services:
  stirling-pdf:
    image: ghcr.io/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      - ENABLE_ORCA_MODE=false
      - ENABLE_PDF_SERVICES=false
      - ENABLE_UNGOTIATE=false
      - ENABLE_STAPLER=false
      - DISABLE_ADDONS=true
    volumes:
      - ./stirling:/usr/share/stirling

name: uptime-kuma
description: Fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with an Uptime Robot-like UI.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - ./uptime-kuma:/app/data

name: changedetection
description: Track webpage changes and get notifications on updates.
compose:
services:
  changedetection:
    image: dgtlmoon/changedetection.io:latest
    container_name: changedetection
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./changedetection:/datastore

name: filebrowser
description: Manage files on your server via a web UI.
compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    container_name: filebrowser
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    environment:
      - FB_ENGINES=sqlite3
    volumes:
      - ./filebrowser:/var/lib/filebrowser
      - /:/app/files:ro

name: glance
description: Dashboard for your home monitoring — simple, fast, privacy-focused.
compose:
services:
  glance:
    image: ghcr.io/glance-hq/glance:latest
    container_name: glance
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro

name: coolify
description: Open-source & self-hostable PaaS — deploy apps, databases, and more.
compose:
services:
  coolify:
    image: docker.io/coolify/coolify:4
    container_name: coolify
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./coolify:/app/data
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:rw
